prompts.level_1: Disambiguate on-foot, vehicle, aircraft, combat, phone, menu, and mission contexts. Preserve visible vehicles, targets, roads, destinations, and interaction prompts.
prompts.level_2: Summarize the mission phase, drive, chase, combat sequence, traversal, interaction, or preparation sub-goal.
prompts.level_3: State the long-horizon mission, escape, pursuit, travel, combat, or open-world objective.
prompts.continuity: Treat driving, pursuit, combat, and interaction as continuous when they advance the same mission phase; split on mission reset, cutscene transition, character switch, unrelated destination, or a clear change of objective.
